title: Netanyahu Loses the Speaker Vote, Riyadh PIF Tower Hit, Hasina's Return Plan | Daily Crux
description_html:
Is Netanyahu's grip on power slipping? Israel's opposition has taken the Knesset speaker's chair, a Houthi missile strike damages the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh, and Sheikh Hasina's planned return sets Bangladesh on edge. Plus today's headlines: the Shenzhen summit declaration, the record oil and gas disruption, Iran and Kuwait, Yongbyon, Ukraine and the EU loan, Somalia and the UAE, France, Spain, US measles status, Venezuela, Myanmar, Meta's AI agent, GTA 6 and Voyager 1, and India's headlines: Prince William and Catherine in India, the India vs New Zealand Test and Delhi's air quality.
